description: This is a JavaScript localization file for the Select2 library, providing Serbian Cyrillic translations for interface messages used in the select2 plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when loading results fails.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the user's input exceeds the maximum allowed length, with proper pluralization.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the user needs to type more characters, with proper pluralization.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns the message shown when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns the message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected, with pluralization.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns the message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns the message displayed while searching.
